label.devLabel:
This utility will gather operating system performance data while you perform the workflow that causes a performance issue. No audio or video will be captured.
After you stop the data gathering process, you will be shown a questionnaire to provide more details about the issue you are experiencing. You can skip the data gathering portion and just fill out the questionnaire if you prefer.
When finished, the system information and questionnaire will be sent to the Fusion team for analysis.
